faqs.q: Sec. 78-46. - Methods of acquisition or improvement; generally.
faqs.a:
Any construction work for or acquisition of any project shall be done in any one or
               more of the following four ways by:
(1)
Independent contract;
(2)
Use of municipally owned or leased equipment and municipal officers, agents and employees;
(3)
Any public body or by the federal government acquiring or improving a project or any
                  interest therein which is herein authorized which results in general benefits to the
                  city and in special benefits to the assessable property being assessed therefor by
                  the city within its boundaries; or
(4)
Purchase of existing improvements at a cost determined acceptable by the city. In
                  such case, nothing in
sections 78-50
through
78-64
, inclusive, shall be applicable.
(Code 1981, § 27-47; Ord. No. 551, § 18(A), 5-14-1964; Ord. No. 2294, § 2, 7-7-1986)
